Elon Musk amended his lawsuit against OpenAI, asking that any damages (he is seeking over $150B from OpenAI and Microsoft) go to OpenAI's nonprofit arm instead of him personally. He also wants CEO Sam Altman and President Greg Brockman removed from the nonprofit board, plus any equity they hold surrendered to it.

He claims OpenAI deviated from its original nonprofit mission (founded in 2015 with him as co-chair) after he left in 2019, shifting to for-profit with Microsoft. Trial set for later this month in Oakland, CA.

THE ARTEMIS II ECLIPSE  
April 6, 2026  

From lunar orbit, the Moon fully eclipsed the Sun — delivering totality beyond Earth.  

The Artemis II crew captured this breathtaking view during their historic flyby: the Moon’s dark silhouette blocking our star against a starry backdrop, with the Sun’s glowing corona visible in a way never seen from our planet.  

This rare alignment happened as the four astronauts aboard Orion traveled farther from Earth than any humans since Apollo, breaking the distance record while conducting science observations on the Moon’s far side.  

A cosmic milestone on the road back to the Moon. 🚀🌑☀️

Tesla Owners of Kentucky (@KentuckyToc)

I know this is a Tesla Owners account, but I'm posting this on X on behalf of a fellow Tesla and Rivian owner. It's a lengthy one, but I would appreciate if everyone would repost to get some traction on this.

On Feb 13, 2026, I took my pristine 2023 R1T to the Shepherdsville, KY service center for a tow bolt recall. During the service, the truck fell off the lift, causing over $32K in damage.
At first, @Rivian did the right thing. The regional service manager called and promised to replace my truck with a new one "for my betterment, not to my detriment." I spent the next few days sending over inventory specs I liked.
Then, Risk Management stepped in. They reversed the decision and said they would only repair it. I refused due to diminished value and safety concerns.
The truck was ultimately deemed a total loss by Rivian’s insurance, but the payout does not cover the cost of a replacement.
I have reached out to the executive team and the Governance Board via signed FedEx letters. I have received zero response.
I’m a long-time EV advocate (coming from a Tesla) and have an R2 reservation on file. I loved driving my truck, but Rivian caused this damage and needs to stand by their initial promise to make me whole.
